t: Key events: Islamic Caliphates & Middle East
cards: Surena's Parthian army destroys the Roman army of Crassus at Carrhae

Ali ibn Buya takes Fars and makes Shiraz his base
Ahmad ibn Buya enters Baghdad and the brothers receive their titles

Death of Adud al-Dawla, followed by rivalry among his sons
Tughril Beg enters Baghdad and ends Buyid rule in Iraq

Trebizond becomes a vassal of the Mongols

Alexios III begins a long reign that restores order

Abu Said dies without an heir and the Ilkhanate fragments
David VI Narin withdraws to Kutaisi and founds a western kingdom

Solomon I defeats the Ottomans at Chikhori

Osman I defeats a Byzantine force at the Battle of Bapheus
Orhan captures Bursa, the dynasty's first true capital
Mehmed II captures Constantinople after a siege of some fifty-three days
Suleiman the Magnificent destroys the Hungarian royal army at Mohács
Jan III Sobieski routs the Ottoman army at the second siege of Vienna
The Tanzimat reforms begin to modernise administration and law

Qara Yuluk Osman defeats and kills Kadi Burhan al-Din
Uzun Hasan defeats and kills the Qara Qoyunlu ruler Jahan Shah

Death of Ya’qub opens a decade of succession wars
Ismail defeats Alvand at Sharur and takes Tabriz

Ivan the Terrible marries Maria Temryukovna, daughter of the Kabardian prince Temryuk

Russia founds Mozdok, beginning its advance into Kabarda

Circassian delegates meet in a united assembly at Sochi
Russia ends Circassian resistance; mass deportation to the Ottoman Empire
Ismail I defeats the Aq Qoyunlu, seizes Tabriz and proclaims Twelver Shiism the state religion

Shah Abbas I's reformed army recovers Herat and Khorasan from the Uzbeks

Babur defeats Ibrahim Lodi at the First Battle of Panipat and founds the empire
Babur defeats the Rajput confederacy of Rana Sanga at Khanwa
Humayun recovers Delhi after years of exile under Sher Shah Suri's rule
Akbar begins his reign, turning a fragile conquest into a stable empire

Qawasim traditionally said to establish their rule at Sharjah

Sultan bin Saqr signs the General Maritime Treaty with Britain

Imperial Airways opens a rest house and airfield at Sharjah
Britain deposes Sheikh Saqr bin Sultan
Sharjah joins the United Arab Emirates on 2 December
Nader expels the Ghilzai Afghans from Isfahan after seven years of occupation
Nader is proclaimed Shah after a great assembly on the Mughan plain

Nader defeats the Ottomans at Kars

Border war with North Yemen; treaty of friendship with the Soviet Union

The first of six wars against the Houthi movement begins in Saada

A Saudi-led coalition intervenes in the war
A Presidential Leadership Council takes over the recognised government
